about.title: About
about.tagline: Parcel delivery between individuals and carriers, anywhere in Algeria.
about.mission: Sending a parcel from one wilaya to another still too often relies on informal contacts, while thousands of trips run empty. UCOLIS connects the two: the sender posts the parcel, carriers already on the road propose a price, and the delivery is tracked live until handover.
about.step1: From, to and a few details: a suggested price is calculated for you.
about.step2: Carriers propose their price; compare, negotiate and choose.
about.step3: Live carrier location, messaging and calls.
about.step4: The recipient gives the delivery code: the delivery is complete.
about.value1: ID, driving licence, vehicle registration and insurance checked by our team.
about.value2: Set by the market, with a suggested price based on distance and weight.
about.value3: Clear statuses, GPS tracking and a delivery code.
about.value4: All {{n}} wilayas, in French, Arabic and English.

permissions.locationBody: During the delivery, UCOLIS shares your location only with the sender of this parcel, so they can track it in real time. Sharing starts when you start the delivery and stops at handover, cancellation or when you log out. Your location is also shared while the app is in the background or the screen is off.
permissions.locationDenied: Without background location, the sender will see “Tracking unavailable”.
permissions.locationForegroundOnly: Background tracking is not available: keep the app open during the delivery so the sender can follow you.
